scene.premise: Paradise calls catastrophe property loss; Lexen forces the room to name children, pain, hunger, and the cost of being real.
setting: Artificial feeds surrounding the only unmanufactured presence

beats.label: Paradise abstracts
beats.action: Executives itemize a destroyed orbital facility, two hundred staff deaths, lost AI frameworks, and stolen children as institutional liabilities.

beats.label: Lexen makes it concrete
beats.action: Lexen names the children, simulated sweetness, dirt, hunger, pain, and the price of waking.

beats.label: The enclosure reverses
beats.action: Lexen rejects the executives’ assumption that the glass contains him.

beats.label: Control fails
beats.action: The bag swings, lights and feeds die, holograms vanish, and glass breaks.

dialogue.speaker: Chairman
dialogue.text: We’re here to discuss the destruction of property. The orbital facility designated Paradise Vault. The deaths of two hundred staff. The loss of critical AI frameworks and—

dialogue.speaker: Lexen
dialogue.text: I saved them. From you. From your simulations. From your perfect little dreams.

dialogue.speaker: Lexen
dialogue.text: You think I’m trapped in here.

dialogue.speaker: Lexen
dialogue.text: You’re in the cage with me.

dialogue.speaker: Lexen
dialogue.text: And you tapped out before the fight even started.
